integrity: New contributions distinguish the previously known singular-support descriptions and classical Cayley cubic from the conductor, normalization, Jacobian scheme and isomorphism theorem.
scientific_limitations: Over complex numbers and \(m,n\ge2\) only; the normalization remains four-nodal (not a smooth resolution); analytic forms are completed-local. No claim of absolute publication priority or external validation.
title: One Cayley normalization, infinitely many Chebyshev conductor grids
